rca_of_the_issue: TierPricingGrid.js was split into 3 files (TierPricingGrid, tier/TierCardParts, InstallmentModal). The Button import inside TierCardParts used '../ui/button', which was correct when the file lived at components/coaching/, but after being moved into components/coaching/tier/ it now resolves to components/coaching/ui/button (which doesn't exist). Correct path is '../../ui/button'. This was caught immediately on first frontend page load (webpack overlay 'Compiled with problems'). Fix applied by test agent.
